scenicChapters.title: Sacred Valley Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 60 km this is Sacred Valley Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-segment-patacancha-huacahuasi-seg.story: 401 km from Lares to Lares, about 6 h 55 of riding. The stops in between: Segment Plaza Inca Hanan: Hauk’aypataqolla, Segment Portada Rumiqolqa-ch’Uspitacana, Segment Cusipata-Santa Cruz de Occobamba N and Segment Machaqmarka-Raqchi-Qquea. The highest point is about 4,450 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
